thread:
marina: Heads up — after the RBAC rollout that tightened svc-account scope this morning, cert issuance in ap-southeast-1 is failing for 3 internal services (ingest-proxy, cache-sync, telemetry-agent). Observed ~30% of requests get `KMS:DecryptAccessDenied`.
ajay: ack, seeing alerts. Which role change specifically?
marina: we removed `iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` on a shared infra principal and replaced it with a narrower set. The cert-issuer job uses that principal to unwrap keys and sign CSRs.
sec-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1784 (label: kms-decrypt-deny). All relevant audit events are being collected to /var/log/sec/audit-stream.
keystore-rotator: automated note: rotator saw 502s while calling kms in ap-southeast-1 at 09:12-09:18 UTC; recorded errors: `AccessDeniedException: not authorized to decrypt`.
leo: paste of the last 5 decrypt log lines from edge-keystore (scrubbed):
```
2026-03-23T09:13:07Z edge-keystore[pid=2124]: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException (keyId: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01)
2026-03-23T09:13:07Z edge-keystore[pid=2124]: principal=infra-build-svc@redwood.local action=Decrypt
2026-03-23T09:13:08Z edge-keystore[pid=2124]: fallback to ephemeral cache miss
2026-03-23T09:14:01Z cert-issuer[pid=778]: CSR sign failed: downstream keystore error
2026-03-23T09:14:02Z cert-issuer[pid=778]: rolling back request id=tx-9d7f
```
ops-sre: quick check — is the key policy tied to the old principal? If so rebind won't work until we update KMS key policy or reattach role.
marina: runbook attempt: I first tried reapplying the previous role, but the RBAC change was done across a few org-level bindings; I'm hesitant to revert without a scoped plan.
ajay: can we add a temporary allow on the KMS key for the new principal until we validate? We should also snapshot current key policy and CloudTrail events.
leo: I queried CloudTrail: 3 Deny events for `Decrypt` from `infra-build-svc` between 09:12-09:20 UTC, then 40+ failed `GetCertificate` from cert-issuer.
sec-bot: Audit note: https://audit.internal/redwood/events?incident=INC-2026-1784 (obfuscated link). Make sure to capture the `AssumeRole` chain.
marina: proposed mitigation steps: 1) temporarily add `kms:Decrypt` for the cert-issuer role on the key policy (scoped to ap-southeast-1 key ARN). 2) enable request-level logging on cert-issuer for 1 hour. 3) run a targeted canary to issue 10 certs. 4) follow up with a postmortem and RBAC policy owner review.
ops-sre: +1 to the plan. Please ensure least-privilege: only allow the exact role ARN, timebox to 60 minutes, and create a revert change.
ajay: I'll prepare the IAM/KMS delta with exact JSON and a change window. Marina — can you attach the cert-issuer call trace so we can prove root cause?
marina: attaching the trace here (excerpt): `issuer_call: role=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cert-issuer-prod assumers=[infra-build-svc@infra] tokenSource=sts:AssumeRole` — looks like after RBAC tweak the assumers list no longer included the infra principal.
leo: small gotcha: cert-issuer runs with a short-lived session that requires `sts:AssumeRole`. If upstream principal can't assume, KMS decrypt denies will show even if key policy permits. Confirm both KMS and STS logs.
marina: noted. action items: (marina) open quick change to key policy with timebox, (ajay) prepare infra RBAC revert delta if needed, (leo) pull CloudTrail+STS logs and put into incident folder, (ops-sre) run canary and monitor.
keystore-rotator: automated note: once key policy updated, rotator will reattempt pending unwraps every 30s for 15 minutes.
ops-sre: live note — applied emergency change to KMS key policy to allow `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cert-issuer-prod` decrypt for 60m. Monitoring canary: started 09:38 UTC.
marina: canary results at 09:41: 10/10 certs minted, no further `AccessDenied` in logs for edge-keystore. Rolling restart of cert-issuer not required.
ajay: I'll follow up with a minimal RBAC adjustment that restores `sts:AssumeRole` path for the infra principal only for cert issuance.
leo: we should add an alert rule for `KMS:DecryptAccessDenied` spikes per-region >=5/min so we catch this quicker next time.
marina: agreed. Also documenting root cause: a cascade from org-level RBAC tightening -> missing assumer in role trust relationship -> STS assume fails -> KMS decrypt calls performed under a principal not authorized -> AccessDenied on KMS key policy surface.
sec-bot: Incident update: mitigated; postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Remember to attach the change diff and audit logs. :white_check_mark:
marina: thanks all. I'll draft the postmortem with timeline and proposed guardrails (pre-rollout cert-issuance smoke, scoped key policy change template, and an automated RBAC-to-KMS preflight check).
